title: Spring 2027 Internship
field: Communications and development (economics, public or business administration, environmental studies)
about: The UNDP office in Washington, D.C., United States, accepts applications for its Spring 2027 internship from graduate students in communications or development-related fields. Applications (CV, signed application form, one reference letter) go by email; the deadline is 15 January 2027, 11:59 pm ET.
requirements: Graduate-level students in communications or a development-related field
Must plan to return to studies after the internship

upskill.name: AI for Email & Professional Communication
why: "Graduate-level students in communications or a development-related field" → "Adapt tone, style, length, level of formality, and language according to different audiences and professional situations."
"Communications and development" → "Use AI to draft, revise, and respond to professional emails while preserving the intended message and communication objective."
